name: Dragon Diggers Day Detecting
description: This is our second visit to this farm. Loads of history here including iron age, roman medieval. This time we have a special surprise but it will mean a 10 to 15 minute walk if you want to visit it. The land this time will be mostly pasture and again sorry but absolutely NO DOGS, due to the sheep in the fields. ncmd insurance or equivalent a must as well as perfect hole filling. £20 per detectorist under 16s and spade carriers free. Tea and Coffee on arrival
